hypothesis: Asking each of E002's four Luna calls for two whole files (A, its best reading, and B, which takes the other plausible reading of the one or two points A had to guess at) raises all-pass over E002, because the right reading of a shared misreading enters the pool at no extra call and the unchanged Sol judge picks it.

Appending to every coder prompt a short, task-agnostic brief on large and degenerate hidden inputs (work bounded by the data actually present, no preallocation from caller-supplied counts, worst-case cost, size overflow) raises all-pass over E002 by removing the performance and size failures that every sample shares and no selector can fix.

When samples 1–3 already yield at least 2 distinct public-green files, replacing the 4th independent sample with a dissent sample (Luna sees those files, lists the behaviours they agree on that no visible test pins down, and writes its own solution following the literal requirement on the one or two points they most plausibly misread) raises all-pass over E002.
